question: How will the text address the substantialist view of impurity and the bonds?
premises: The substantialist view of impurity has been presented.
The author considers it condemned by reasoning and scripture.
The true status of impurity, māyā, and karma will be explained later.
inference: The text postpones a fuller refutation and will later establish the proper status of the three bonds.
plain_english: We shall refute that view later, since it is condemned by both reasoning and scripture, and we shall show the true status of impurity, māyā, and karma.
